notes: GAAP audit, FYE 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); 'Bond and loan proceeds' 1,910,862 is printed among revenues, so it is a receipt line (Debt Proceeds). Business-type from the proprietary funds statement Total column (p7). Business-type receipts total = operating revenues + nonoperating interest and grant income (no single printed total); business-type disbursements = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 2,842,497 (p2) = operating 2,787,760 + bond issuance costs 6,961 + interest 42,591 + loan fees 5,185. Utility 'Other revenue' is in charges for services because the Statement of Activities charges for services (2,736,131) equal total operating revenues. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents' 3,247,625 (p4); county treasurer cash 37,721 printed separately. Detail: General Fund recorded from the departmental combining statement (pp15-16, department columns) rather than the GF budgetary comparison (p10, budget basis, totals 3,369,626 / 2,617,436) to avoid double counting (as FY2023). Street, Special Assessments and EMS from their budget schedules (pp11-13; zero-actual budget lines Street 'Charges for services' and 'Transfers in' omitted). Nonmajor funds per fund from p14 (Historic Lighting fund had no activity). No business-type detail (no separate proprietary schedule; as FY2023/FY2024). Proprietary cash flows Total column on p9 (continuation of p8). Component units (Airport Authority, CRA) excluded. Read pages 1-16 of 16
